title: Pairwise commutation of the exact good-prime Hecke operators
statement: For every natural number M with M ≠ 0, every pair of natural primes p and r with p ∤ M and r ∤ M, and every corresponding proof witnesses, the complex-linear endomorphisms CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM and CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hr hrM of CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2 commute under composition.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (p r : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) (hrM : ¬ r ∣ M), (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM).comp (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hr hrM) = (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hr hrM).comp (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM)
